name: London
tagline: London's oldest restaurant, since 1798, and the fish and chips that hasn't changed since 1914.

Rules.description: London's oldest restaurant, since 1798. Dickens and Charlie Chaplin both dined within its walls.

The Golden Hind.description: Traditional fish and chips in Marylebone since 1914.

Core by Clare Smyth.description: Clare Smyth, the first and only British female chef with three Michelin stars, in Notting Hill.

Borough Market.description: One of London's oldest food markets, with more than a thousand years of history next to London Bridge.

St. John.description: The restaurant that popularized nose-to-tail cooking, in Smithfield. One Michelin star.
